name: io.github.SandstromPL/whyreach
title: whyreach
description: Read-only Docker network diagnosis: why one container can't reach another, with evidence.

runtimeArguments.name: --network
runtimeArguments.description: Puts whyreach in the host's network namespace, where it sees the host's interfaces, listening sockets and connections.

runtimeArguments.name: --pid
runtimeArguments.description: Lets whyreach read the containers' listening sockets through /proc/<pid>/net, without probe containers.

runtimeArguments.name: -v
runtimeArguments.description: The Docker API: whyreach reads metadata through an allowlist of endpoints and writes nothing unless you allow probe containers.
